annotations.title: Get a link to open a document

description: A link the signed-in customer clicks to open one of their company's documents on the firm's website, after signing them in: a file from find_company_documents (folder_id and file_id), a letter from list_letters (letter_id), or a signing request from list_signing_requests (signing_request_id). Give one of the three. The document never comes into the chat.

signing_request_id.description: The signing request's id, from list_signing_requests.
